notes: --prompt-file avoids argv limits. The default --permission-mode auto approves only read-only tools.

acp.notes: Ignores session/new mcpServers: the session runs in a fresh temp cwd holding .mcp.json with the toolkit server. Its MCP tools sit behind a lookup tool: a prompt that does not name the MCP server 'toolnexus' may never find them (live 2026-11-04: 0/3 without, 3/3 with), so systemHint names it on every ACP turn.
acp.systemHint: Your tools include those of the MCP server named "toolnexus". When the request needs a tool, look up the toolnexus MCP server and use its tools.
